get.description: Filters combine with AND. fromUtc is inclusive, toUtc exclusive; timestamps must be UTC. Ordered by occurredAtUtc then eventId descending. page defaults to 1; pageSize defaults to 20 and is capped at 100. No write endpoint is exposed.
